Topic.label: Applications of Probability and Fairness in Games

Question: Each of 2 people rolls a die. Player A wins if the sum of the numbers rolled is even, and Player B wins if it is odd. Is the game fair? (Give the probabilities of Player A and Player B winning, in that order, as fractions in simplest form, separated by a comma.)
Solution: There are 36 equally likely outcomes in total. An even sum requires both numbers to have the same parity, giving 18 outcomes. There are also 18 outcomes with an odd sum. The probabilities of Player A and Player B winning are both \(1/2\), so the game is fair.

Original.prompt: 两人各掷一枚骰子，点数和为偶数甲胜，奇数乙胜，公平吗？（请依次写出甲、乙获胜的概率，结果写成最简分数，用逗号隔开）
Original.explanation: 共 36 种等可能结果，和为偶数需两个点数同奇偶，有 18 种，和为奇数也有 18 种，甲、乙获胜概率都是 1/2，所以游戏公平。
Original.verify: [Fraction(len([1 for t in range(36) if (t//6+t%6)%2==0]),36), Fraction(len([1 for t in range(36) if (t//6+t%6)%2==1]),36)]
